blender noun

modern

Traupman 280

māchina concīsōria

Traupman explicitly gives this appliance name; it was visually verified in Traupman, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 281).

Other words

  • māchina mixtōria

    also used · modern · M-O

    A recorded alternative blender name in Morgan–Owens; not a name for an ancient appliance.

  • māchina liquātōria

    also used · modern · M-O

See also machine, jug, lid, blade, button, blend.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF: printed pp. 70–73 (food and drink), 124 (refrigerator), 280 (blender), 358 (peanut butter), 383 (spinach). Printed page numbers are one less than PDF page numbers in this copy. The blender entry on printed p. 280 was also checked against its rendered page.
